title: Websim gets a cleaner home and Bearer authentication
summary:
A small infrastructure day: cleaner Websim auth and shared concurrency plumbing.

websim.pollinations.ai was moved into the root directory and now uses Bearer auth, making the service layout and access path more consistent.

Tier-based concurrency logic was extracted into a shared ipQueue module, giving services one reusable way to manage request capacity instead of growing their own queue ecosystems.
